Our Process

Kaam Kaise Hota Hai

SEO aur visibility ka kaam ek saaf process se hota hai — har step par aap ko pata hota hai ke kya ho raha hai.

01 — Audit

Aap ki website, pages aur maujooda visibility ka mukammal jaiza — kya theek hai aur kya behtar karna hai.

02 — Strategy

Keyword research aur competitor ke jaize ki buniyad par saaf plan aur priorities tay hoti hain.

03 — Implementation

On-page, technical aur AI search visibility ka kaam aap ki approval ke saath live hota hai.

04 — Monitoring

Monthly reporting ke saath progress dekhi jati hai aur plan ko behtar kiya jata rehta hai.

      FAQ

      Aksar Poochay Jaane Walay Sawalat

      Keyword research, on-page aur technical SEO, AI search visibility ka kaam aur monthly reporting. Package PKR 70,000 per month hai aur minimum muddat 6 months hai, kyunki SEO ke nateeje waqt ke saath bante hain.

      Nahi — aur koi bhi honest agency ye guarantee nahi de sakti, kyunki rankings Google ke control mein hain. Hum sahi process, regular kaam aur saaf reporting ki zimmedari lete hain, jaali waade nahi karte.

      Kyunki in ka kaam har client ke hisaab se badalta hai — kisi ke 10 posts hain, kisi ke 30; kisi ke 5 Etsy listings hain, kisi ke 100. Scope sun kar exact quote diya jaata hai, taake aap sirf apne kaam ki qeemat den.

      Tools page par sirf teen AI tools hain, aur teeno ki price tay hai: Muse AI PKR 300, Flow AI PKR 1,000 aur ChatGPT PKR 1,000. Kisi bhi tool ke card par “WhatsApp Par Buy Karen” dabayen — aap seedha hamare WhatsApp par aa jayenge, jahan tool ka naam aur price pehle se likha hoga.

      Fees aur batch dates finalize ho rahe hain. Courses page par apne course par tap karen — wahan us ki mukammal tafseel aur neeche registration form mil jayega. Form bharne walon ko fees aur batch ki khabar sab se pehle milegi, aur abhi koi advance payment nahi li ja rahi.

      Jee, bilkul. Aap ke saare accounts, pages aur shops aap ki milkiyat rehte hain. Hum sirf un par kaam karte hain, aur har bara step aap ki approval se hota hai.
